lines.name: The Old Tongue
lines.how: You prayed at three of the cult's shrines, and the third one answered.

lines.name: The Last Pilgrim
lines.how: You fed three pilgrims on the road. The third one knew your name.

lines.name: What the God Saw
lines.how: You dreamt five dreams, then slept a night in the Aether.

lines.name: Sky and Fire
lines.how: You carried something from the Aether into the Nether, and the Nether went quiet.

lines.name: Clean Hands
lines.how: You reached Act IV without killing a single villager or story character.
